description: MainActivity2.kt defines the MainActivity2 class, which is the entry point of an Android recipe application. It manages bottom navigation and swaps different UI fragments (Home, Categories, Favorites) based on user interaction.

classes.name: MainActivity2
classes.description: The main activity class hosting the bottom navigation and fragment swapping logic for the recipe app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, sets up bottom navigation listener, and defaults to the HomeFragment.

methods.name: switchFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the specified fragment in the container.
